chunks: 5082 - Ibn Mahbub narrated from Malik ibn Atiyyah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman who slanderously accused a man, he عليه السلام said: “She is to be flogged eighty lashes.”

key_terms.تُجْلَدُ: she is to be flogged as a legal punishment
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty, specifying the number of lashes
key_terms.جَلْدَةً: lashes, the unit of corporal punishment
key_terms.رَجُلًا: a man, the person against whom the accusation was made
key_terms.قَذَفَتْ: she falsely accused with slander of illicit sexual conduct
key_terms.ٱمْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the subject of the legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment in Shia fiqh for a woman who falsely accuses a man of adultery?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning qadhf, the false accusation of illicit sexual conduct. It states that when a woman accuses a man in this manner, the prescribed hadd punishment is eighty lashes.
